CONSOLIDATED VEHICULAR MEC EDGE GATEWAY (Raspberry Pi 5 • ARM Cortex-A76)
Streamlined 4-Container Mesh • Native oneM2M TS-0010 MQTT Binding • In-CSE Multi-Hazard Health Engine
• Mutual TLS 1.3 Termination (ECDSA P-256 Auth • Hardware Crypto)
• Strict Perimeter Security; isolates vehicular network from cloud/IP hops
• Direct TS-0010 Loopback Binding to ACME CSE on Port 1883 (/oneM2M)
CSEBase: /sdv-cse • CSE-ID: id-sdv • Release 4 (RVI 3) • Web UI: 8081
• Auto-decodes /oneM2M/req/ primitives → Directly maps JSON to <m2m:cin> without intermediary IPE
• Downlink Subscriptions dispatch directly to MQTT notification URIs (nu: ["mqtt://..."]) • Zero HTTP overhead
• In-CSE Retention & Buffer Bound: 24h Ring Buffer • Missing Data Dropout Detect
acme-scripts • Multi-Hazard Health Engine (Replaces Bridge AE)
Native onCreate Trigger on cnt_raw-telemetry • Evaluates 4-State Health Machine directly in CSE:
• In-CSE Deterministic Health Evaluation Rules (Embedded Execution):
1. Latency Freshness: τ_age = t_eval − t_sample ≤ 2.5s (STALE if τ > 2.5s, FAULT if τ > 10s)
2. Thermal Divergence: ΔT = |T_SCD30 − T_DHT22| ≤ 1.5 °C (DEGRADED if ΔT > 1.5 °C)
3. Humidity Divergence: ΔRH = |RH_SCD30 − RH_DHT22| ≤ 10.0% (DEGRADED if ΔRH > 10%)
4. Blower Stall Fault: (PWM ≥ 30%) AND (Tachometer RPM < 100) ⇒ FAULT (Motor Jam / Line Break)
5. Toxic Gas Guard: CO ≥ 30.0 ppm ⇒ CRITICAL HAZARD ⇒ Direct In-CSE Downlink Override
6. Damper Flap Control: ΔIAQ = IAQ_exterior − IAQ_cabin ⇒ Automatic Cabin Recirculation Lock
• Native oneM2M Subscription Channels & Event Notification:
1. sub_downlink: Direct MQTT URI (nu: ["mqtt://..."]) → Vehicle Actuators | 2. sub_co_alert → /emergency-monitor
• Committed Measurement: cabin_telemetry • Retention Policy: 30 days • High-Throughput Write API
• Ingested via direct oneM2M subscription stream / Telegraf (Zero intermediary Python container required)
• Flux Query Engine provides sub-second downsampling, windowed statistics, and real-time trends
• Serves High-Frequency Queries directly to Grafana Cockpit (Cabin CO₂, Temperature, RH, Actuator States)
✓ Decoupled TSDB Architecture preserves In-CSE RAM while retaining 30-day multi-vehicle fleet history
Port 3000 • Live Multi-Vehicle Telemetry • In-CSE Actuator Closed-Loop Verification
Evaluated natively by In-CSE Scripting Engine (acme-scripts) • Zero external container latency
Trigger: Active if RH > 65% OR Status Degraded
STATUS: FRESH AIR INTAKE OPEN (Ext AQI: 28 < Cabin IAQ: 42 • ΔIAQ = −14)
✓ TOXIC GAS HAZARD GUARD: CO SAFE (0.2 ppm • CLEAR)
In-CSE direct downlink emergency interlock armed
RULE 1: Elevated Carbon Dioxide (CO₂ > 800 ppm OR Temp > 24.0 °C)
Action: Scale Blue LED Purge Fan PWM → 75% Duty Cycle (Tachometer confirms 1,850 RPM)
Action: Energise Red LED Auxiliary Heater Core • Maintain minimum 20% baseline airflow
RULE 3: High Relative Humidity / Fogging Risk (RH > 65.0%)
Action: Energise Amber LED Dehumidification Core • Increase purge blower airflow
RULE 4: Emergency Toxic Gas Event (CO ≥ 30.0 ppm)
Action: IMMEDIATE 100% Purge OVERRIDE • Fire sub_co_alert • Open Fresh Air Flap
RULE 5: Mechanical Motor Stall Check (PWM ≥ 30% AND Tachometer RPM < 100)
Action: Flag FAULT State • Transition WS2812B to Red • Inhibit Heater Core to prevent overheating
• Perimeter Cryptography: Mosquitto handles mTLS 1.3 handshakes, preventing CSE Python thread starvation.
• Native Semantic Ingestion: ACME TS-0010 MQTT binding directly constructs oneM2M resources without Node-RED.
• In-CSE Health Verification: Deterministic multi-hazard rules execute inside ACME scripts with zero network latency.
• Dedicated Time-Series Storage: InfluxDB isolates high-frequency writes from CSE SQLite metadata storage.
• Fail-Safe Hardware Loop: Microcontroller FreeRTOS core independently enforces 50% fallback if link is lost.
